preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 500.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 1000 for N in Ns)
preconditions.description: Each test case N is between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases T.

postconditions.expression: all(len(array) == N for array, N in zip(output, Ns))
postconditions.description: Each output array has exactly N elements.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= x <= 1000 for x in array) for array in output)
postconditions.description: All elements in each output array are between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(all(array.count(x) % 2 == 0 for x in set(subarray)) for subarray in [array[i:j] for i in range(len(array)) for j in range(i+1, len(array)+1)])) for array in output)
postconditions.description: No subarray in each output array has all elements occurring in even frequency.

postconditions.expression: all(max(array) == min(max(array) for array in output) for array in output)
postconditions.description: The maximum element in each output array is minimized across all test cases.
